prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Test dragging, hiding, and summoning your pet on your desktop before completing setup."]
1: ["Secure Pet Profile Cloud Sync", "Link your account to save your companion traits and memory automatically across app sessions.", "Cloud Backup Enabled", "Existing pets on your account will be restored automatically upon sign in."]
2: ["Photo Clarity & Alignment Inspector", "Check photo lighting and angle before processing to guarantee optimal 3D desktop companion rendering.", "Live Rendering Mesh Preview", "Lighting, angle, and background clarity check"]
3: ["Select Companion Path", "Choose your path to begin setting up your interactive desktop companion.", "A quick screen rendering compatibility check will follow."]
4: ["Your Companion Is Initializing", "Sample companion sounds and preview desktop animations while your pet loads.", "Preview Pet Sounds", "Idle Behavior Teasers"]
5: ["Companion Desk Ready", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Hotkey: Press Ctrl+Alt+P to hide or summon your companion instantly anytime.", "Shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + P"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Registry Certificate", "Name your companion and sign the digital adoption deed to register your pet.", "Pet Companion Name", "Official Digital Deed"]
7: ["Meet Your Always-On Desktop Companion", "A digital pet living directly on your Windows desktop that reacts to clicks and keeps you company.", "Start Companion Setup"]
8: ["Your data is encrypted. You can wipe local pet memories or delete your account anytime in app settings.", "Privacy First: Full Data Control"]
9: ["Building Pet Companion Assets in Background", "Feel free to use other apps. We will send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready.", "You will be notified on your screen when setup finishes."]

verdicts.problem: Asks the user to sign an official deed, which requests personal signature or personal information.
